sections.headline: More Ways to Build and Protect Your Wealth.
sections.copy: Explore these options with their terms and trade-offs in view. Fixed deposits, bonds, pension planning, and structured solutions have distinct credit risks, liquidity terms, and tax treatments.

sections.title: Corporate Fixed Deposits
sections.copy: Fixed deposits with corporate issuers offer specified interest rates for defined tenures. Corporate FDs carry credit and issuer default risk; credit ratings from rating agencies (CRISIL, ICRA, CARE) indicate creditworthiness at the time of rating.

sections.title: Bonds & Debentures
sections.copy: Government and corporate bonds provide fixed income streams subject to credit risk, interest rate risk, and secondary market liquidity.

sections.title: National Pension System (NPS)
sections.copy: NPS is a voluntary retirement savings scheme governed by PFRDA. Offered through Religare Broking Limited (registration 4199). Features tiered accounts (Tier I with tax deductions and lock-in, and flexible Tier II).

sections.title: Market-Linked Debentures (MLDs)
sections.copy: Structured debt securities whose final yield is tied to the performance of an underlying market index. Subject to market and credit risks; capital is not guaranteed.

sections.title: Real Estate Advisory (Vadodara & Ahmedabad)
sections.copy: Facilitation of commercial and residential property transactions. RERA Gujarat registration is currently under process. Real estate brokerage is not promoted as a guaranteed yield product.

sections.title: Loan Assistance
sections.copy: Assisting clients with documentation and loan sourcing through empanelled banking and NBFC partners, subject to lender underwriting criteria.

sections.content: All investment products involve financial and counterparty risks. Terms and conditions are governed by respective issuers and regulatory bodies.
